inspectionGroups.notes: Separate optional glass connected to SKU34349 driver. This viewing layout and separation offset are debugging arrangements, not physical mounting dimensions.

limitations: SKU34349 is the ESP32-S3 60PIN driver board. The 13.3E6 glass is a separately connected optional display, not an onboard packaged screen or an included part claim.
Driver board thickness, package heights and precise corner-hole positions are estimates. A visible UNKNOWN mark remains on the unmodeled reverse face.
Major driver components are photo-derived simplified shapes; PCB layer stack, fine solder geometry and hidden component details are unknown.
Glass outline and active area are official dimensions. The active-area center offset is a photo estimate; glass-to-board position is a debugging layout only.

The pictured intermediate 60PIN adapter, ribbon routing, screws, spacers and optional speaker/battery are omitted because exact mounting/dimensions are not established. Their absence is explicit, not proof they do not exist.
A static source picture is never placed on the active display. The 1600x1200 surface receives only the emulator framebuffer.
No calibrated manufacturing fit, WebGL/browser visual acceptance or physical hardware verification is claimed by this model build.
